pages.text: MathMod does not plan to use mana or spell cooldowns in the MVP.$(br2)Instead, each rune contributes to a compile-time budget. Better materials can later increase the budget of a talisman or anchor.

pages.title: Why Budget?
pages.text: A budget gives pack authors a build-time balance lever. Rune material requirements are the cast-time lever: survival talismans consume configured items after a successful cast.
